description.en: Explore gold studs and drop earrings, from geometric forms made with granulation to designs with pearls, emeralds and imperial topaz.
description.de: Entdecke Ohrstecker und Ohrringe aus Gold, von geometrischen Formen in Granulationstechnik bis zu Schmuckstücken mit Perlen, Smaragden und Imperialtopas.
description.it: Scopri orecchini a lobo e pendenti in oro, dalle forme geometriche in granulazione ai gioielli con perle, smeraldi e topazio imperiale.
